# Literature review

This replay fixture runs without a literature search (no references are added to the study). The draft cites no work, and the citation check reports that the study has no references.

The methods are standard in corpus linguistics and text-as-data research (log-likelihood keyness, the log ratio, pointwise mutual information, dictionary measures checked on a hand-read sample, NMF topic models with a stability check); the template's method skill and credits name their sources. A real study would situate the counts in the criticism of Gothic and sensation fiction; this fixture states only what the study does.
